note: Set BROKER_TYPE=oanda, BROKER_OANDA_TOKEN, and BROKER_OANDA_ACCOUNT env vars. On first successful OANDA connection the account_id field is overwritten with the real account prefix (first 8 chars + ellipsis) by _stamp_oanda_paper_start() in core/startup_factories.py. The 30-day paper trading clock runs from started_utc.
